title: Suspicious rundll32 Execution from Temp Directory
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    Image|endswith: '\\rundll32.exe'
    CommandLine|contains: 
      - '%TEMP%'
      - '/c'
      - 'http'
  condition: selection
level: high
